# Intro

`scaffolds/intro` · intro · v0.1.0

Logo and wordmark, kicker, display title and an accent rule rising in one after the other on the theme background.

![Intro preview — editorial theme, at 2.8 s](preview.png)

*Preview: the editorial theme, 2.8 s into the component; the manifest's preview samples.*

## Slots

| slot | type | default from | max chars | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` (required) | text | scenario.title.text | 60 | The video title. |
| `kicker` | text | scenario.title.kicker | 40 | Small uppercase line above the title. |
| `logo` | image | theme.logo |  | Logo image (the theme logo by default). |

## Params

| param | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | `center` \| `left` | center | Alignment of the column. |
| `rule` | boolean | true | Draw the accent rule under the title. |
| `stagger` | number (0–0.5) | 0.12 | Seconds between the entrances of two lines. |

- duration 3.2 s (1.5–8 s)
- variants: landscape, vertical
- theme tokens: `colors.accent`, `colors.text`, `background`, `fonts.display`, `fonts.body`, `logo`, `wordmark`
